input:
We integrated a MIPI CSI-2 v4.2 Event-Based Vision Sensor (EVS) for our autonomous robot platform. During fast scene motion (high contrast transitions across many pixels simultaneously), the event stream drops events.

dmesg:
  [  5.100] mipi-csi2: ESP virtual channel 2 overflow, event_count=48000/ms
  [  5.101] csi2_rx: VC2 FIFO overrun, dropped 1200 events
  [  5.102] evs_driver: event gap detected at t=5.100s

The sensor is a Prophesee Metavision at 1MP resolution. The CSI-2 link is D-PHY 4-lane at 2.5Gbps/lane. The event burst rate during the scene transition is estimated at 48,000 events/ms. What causes MIPI-CSI2-ESP-Event-Drop, and how should we configure the CSI-2 virtual channel allocation to handle event bursts?
